Justification of Sample Size
The sample size will be further increased by 5% to account for patients who prematurely withdraw
from the study. Hence, the total sample size will be approximately 76 patients. Patients who
discontinue treatment early and/or withdraw from the study will not be replaced. Results will be
analyzed according to intention-to-treat. The 95% binomial exact confidences intervals for
observed pCR with 76 patients is provided in Table 6.
The non-clinically meaningful pCR rate of 25% will be excluded using the lower limit of 95%
exact CI if the observed pCR rate is 36.8% or more.
